ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Social Turn in Contemporary Art Practice. Graduate Section. This course offers a hands-on approach to contemporary art practices that promote social change, including community and socially engaged art, large-scale installations, situated projects, pedagogical experiences, placemaking, public art, performance, and activism, among others. The semester's outcome will be a class show exhibiting students' projects/practices/interventions that address the question of social justice in our local communities.
